            (cleared, snoozed past expiry, or deleted).

act.web.api.models.Tasks.ClearAlarmsRequ.description: Request model for the bulk clear-alarms operation.

ids.description:
IDs of the alarms to clear. Accepts either the 44-character composite format
            (activityId + MMddyyyy, as returned by the alarms endpoint) or a plain 36-character
            GUID (activityId only). When a GUID-only ID is provided, all occurrences of that
            activity within the configured search range are cleared.
